title: Sr. Full-Stack Engineer (Java/React)
description:
*Native/Bilingual English is required for this role (read/written/spoken)

Please upload your CV Resume in English.

Monthly salary: $4,000 - $5,000 USD

We are seeking  a highly-skilled Senior Full-Stack Software Engineer to join these high-impact teams. You will collaborate closely with design, product, and engineering experts to deliver innovative, real-time solutions that elevate our partners' retail offerings.

What You’ll Do:

You will be expected to operate as a full-stack owner, driving development from the database to the user interface, with a strong commitment to quality and collaboration.

  • Lead the development of high-quality, robust, observable, and measurable applications using a user-centric approach and  disciplined eXtreme Programming (XP) practices .
  • Practice Test-Driven Development (TDD) and  Pair Programming as core, daily engineering functions to ensure code quality and shared ownership.
  • Contribute across the stack, developing business logic with  Java/Spring Boot on the backend and building intuitive user interfaces with  React on the frontend.
  • Design and implement scalable, event-driven solutions utilizing  Kafka .
  • Participate in the entire Agile application lifecycle in collaboration with product managers, designers, and other engineers.
  • Leverage critical thinking, experimentation, data, and industry best practices to implement desired business outcomes.
  • Facilitate team ceremonies and actively give and receive feedback that is empathetic, actionable, and specific.
  • Practice emergent architecture with sane defaults and build software that is easy to use and easy to modify.
  • Lead technical initiatives not only on the team but also across the department.

Team Focus Areas:

Engineers will be assigned to collaborate on the following mission-critical teams focused on modernizing core retail functions. You will be instrumental in the following key initiatives:

Merchandising Systems Modernization
  • Merchandise Assortment Planning (MAP): Build and extend platform interfaces to capture data in software (not spreadsheets), enabling better downstream decision-making.
  • Merchandising Financial Planning: Focus on improving data consistency and quality across major merchandising systems.
Optimization and Allocation Systems
  • Order Optimization: Address intersystem data issues. A key goal is to replace a vendor's size/pack optimization product (SAS) and modernize existing services to use a real-time data source (via Kafka) instead of batch processes.
  • Replenishment: Iterate on and enhance functionality in the new homegrown  ARC system.
  • Allocations: Iterate on and enhance functionality in the new homegrown  KOALA system.

Skills You Have:

Non-Negotiable Requirements

  • 4+ years of professional software development experience, with a focus on full-stack engineering.
  • 4+ years of experience with Java and JEE development, particularly Spring Boot, Spring MVC, and Spring Security.
  • 4+ years of mandatory experience with modern JavaScript and the React framework.
  • Direct experience using Kafka for event-driven architecture.
  • Experience with any relational database (e.g., Postgres, MySQL, Oracle) for design and implementation.
  • Proven, hands-on experience in an XP/Agile environment, including daily Test-Driven Development (TDD) and Pair Programming.
  • In-depth knowledge and experience with continuous integration/continuous deployment (CI/CD).
  • Excellent verbal communication skills —essential for a Pair Programming environment.

description:

Yes, tell me more…

We are building an un-paralleled data collection pipeline which is being deployed on AWS and written in Go and Typescript. With a focus on innovation, quality, and accessibility, we are developing a one-stop lead generator platform.

The Customer facing part of the solution is a Typescript and GraphQL based web application. Deployed on AWS as well. Serverless paradigm is being applied: Most of our code is running as AWS’s Lambda’s.

We are currently hiring a Senior DevOps Engineer with AWS CDK knowledge for an initial 12-month B2B Contract on a remote basis. The ideal candidate will be comfortable with AWS (EDA architecture) and TypeScript and willing to pick up new technologies as needed.

  • A Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science or related field

  • Coding experience in implementing business features
  • Familiarity with AWS services, including Lambda, API Gateway, S3, CloudFront, EventBridge, AppSync, DynamoDb, OpenSearch
  • Business-level proficiency in English

The successful candidate will…

  • Be comfortable working remotely and independently, with some overlap with HQ work schedule
  • Take ownership and be accountable for their work
  • Be eager to work on various aspects of our cloud infrastructure in a generalist role
  • Quickly familiarize themselves with our infrastructure to generate new ideas and improve our existing setup
  • Have experience supporting other teams in implementing AWS solutions
  • Adopt a proactive, hands-on approach

What can you expect from us?

  • To shape the company from the ground up – join our team as a pioneer and help us carve our way forward.
  • Together we’ll take our product to market – how cool would it be to celebrate together? A flat hierarchical structure with room for innovation in a highly motivated team.
  • A start-up environment that is passionate about quality, problem solving and building beautiful software.

Our passion stems from our shared values and mission. With that said, our culture is built on two major aspects:

Quality : At fullinfo we have show-and-tell energy, and we let the quality of our product speak for itself. We love building beautiful software and get hyped by always raising the bar on quality. Our product is beautiful inside and outside. How do we achieve this? By always asking ourselves “Is this right?” or “Does this make sense?”.

Problem Solving : We foster innovation and novel approaches to problem solving, while keeping user needs at front of mind.

  • Planejar e conduzir treinamentos e iniciativas de conscientização para disseminar e garantir a correta aplicação dos procedimentos pelas equipes.

  • Executar outras atividades relacionadas ao Sistema de Gestão da Qualidade, conforme necessário.

Sobre você:

  • Ensino Superior em Engenharia, Gestão da Qualidade ou áreas afins.
  • Mais de 3 anos de experiência em funções relacionadas à qualidade, com familiaridade com rotinas de projetos em empresas de engenharia.

  • Ambivertido.
  • Concentrado.
  • Planejador.

Por que a Ausenco?

Apoiamos o crescimento individual e buscamos permitir que você trabalhe de uma forma que valorize seus pontos fortes e atenda às suas necessidades. Conheça nossa proposta de valor:

  • Remuneração e equilíbrio entre vida profissional e pessoal – Além de um pacote de remuneração competitivo, experimente o melhor dos dois mundos com nosso modelo de trabalho híbrido, que permite equilibrar dias no escritório com trabalho em casa. Aproveite os benefícios de políticas de licença modernas, incluindo licença parental remunerada, e celebre conosco feriados especiais.
  • Avanço na carreira - Receba apoio no seu desenvolvimento contínuo através de treinamentos técnicos, programas de mentoria e frequentes oportunidades de networking.
  • Equilíbrio e Bem-Estar – Adote uma abordagem proativa para o seu bem-estar geral. Tenha acesso a aconselhamento confidencial, serviços de saúde e um programa de benefícios que atenda às suas necessidades.
  • Reconhecimento e Valorização - Participe de espaços multidirecionais onde se fomenta uma cultura de reconhecimento local e global, onde todos são reconhecidos por sua contribuição para os negócios e projetos.
  • Comunicação e Compromisso – Vivencie a experiência de trabalhar em uma empresa dinâmica com processos globais e colabore com líderes de renome no setor que valorizam sua contribuição.

Nossos colaboradores não se contentam com o status quo. Se você tem espírito empreendedor e quer ajudar a estabelecer um novo padrão em sustentabilidade, nós o ajudaremos a encontrar seu lugar. Isso significa trabalhar com você para desenvolver uma trajetória profissional e um conjunto de habilidades únicos, que estejam à altura de sua ambição.

Temos orgulho do trabalho que fazemos e o realizamos dentro de uma cultura aberta, honesta e colaborativa. Temos um histórico de atrair pessoas visionárias que abraçam desafios e entregam soluções criativas para cada projeto, e a sua opinião é uma parte importante dessa conversa.

Como empresa global, valorizamos e incentivamos a diversidade em seu sentido mais amplo – identidade de gênero, expressão de gênero, orientação sexual, idade, experiência, nacionalidade, cor, idioma, religião, localização, deficiência, formação acadêmica, habilidades, estilos de trabalho e disponibilidade de tempo. Nossos ambientes de trabalho são baseados na confiança mútua e no respeito aos direitos e oportunidades de cada indivíduo.

Junte-se a nós e trabalhe de uma maneira melhor.

title: Especialista em Lean
description:

Essa posição liderará a conversão para uma organização enxuta, conduzindo a implementação de ferramentas como:

  • Value Stream Management, Safety, 5S, TPM, Standard Work, Kanban/Pull Systems, Root-Cause Problem Solving, Quality at the Source, Lean Daily Management, SMED, POKE-YOKE, Just-in-time, cellular manufacturing, A3/PDCA Problem Solving.

  • Garantir que segurança e qualidade sejam prioridades em todas as áreas do negócio.

  • Conhecer e aplicar a Política de Qualidade da Weatherford, cumprindo os requisitos do Quality Systems Manual (QSM) e demais procedimentos.
  • Coordenar a implantação do Programa de Lean Manufacturing junto ao gerente de R&M e equipe de liderança da planta.
  • Desenvolver e implementar Value Stream Mapping (VSM), com planos de ação de melhoria contínua.
  • Criar e sustentar processos padronizados em toda a organização.
  • Implementar Shop Daily Management (SDM).
  • Identificar oportunidades de melhoria em colaboração com gestores, supervisores, equipes e clientes, conduzindo projetos de produtividade, redução de desperdícios, eventos Kaizen e outras iniciativas de melhoria contínua.
  • Facilitar a gestão diária Lean e promover a cultura Lean por meio de Gemba Walk, iniciativas de segurança, 5S e gestão visual.
  • Apoiar projetos de melhoria de processos e produtividade, tanto operacionais quanto transacionais, com foco em R&M.
  • Orientar e fornecer suporte à liderança das instalações quanto a princípios, metodologias e ferramentas Lean e/ou Six Sigma.
  • Manter comunicação eficaz com diferentes stakeholders para planejar atividades que atendam aos requisitos do negócio.
  • Garantir alinhamento e comunicação entre as linhas de produto e a área de R&M.
  • Apoiar e treinar a equipe de R&M em projetos de melhoria contínua e Kaizen que gerem resultados financeiros mensuráveis.
  • Ministrar treinamentos sobre Lean, conforme currículo interno.
  • Mentorar, influenciar e desenvolver futuros praticantes Lean.
  • Fornecer liderança necessária para promover mudanças e esforços de transformação Lean em todas as instalações de R&M designadas.

Pré-requisitos:

  • Bacharelado em Engenharia Industrial, Mecânica, de Produção ou Elétrica.
  • Mínimo de 3 a 5 anos de experiência em Lean Manufacturing como líder de melhoria contínua , lean lead, black belt ou função similar.
  • Experiência comprovada como facilitador de Kaizen.
  • Vivência prática com ferramentas: VSM, 5S, 5Porquês, TPM, Trabalho Padrão, Poka-Yoke, SIPOC, Mapeamento de Processos, Kanban, SMED, Hoshin, PDCA/DMAIC etc.
  • Certificação Lean Practitioner e/ou Six Sigma Black Belt (Desejável)
  • Domínio avançado das ferramentas Lean e capacidade de ensinar metodologias.
  • Perfil de liderança, inspirando e motivando equipes.
  • Comunicação eficaz em todos os níveis (chão de fábrica até diretoria).
  • Atitude prática, energia e presença no chão de fábrica.

title: Senior Generative AI Engineer
description:
Senior Generative AI Engineer – Copilot / Power Automate

We’re looking for a Senior Generative AI Engineer who can elevate how teams work with Microsoft Copilot Studio and Power Automate. This role sits at the intersection of AI engineering, process automation, user enablement, and platform governance —perfect for someone who loves building smart systems and helping people use them confidently.

You’ll design and optimize AI agents, troubleshoot complex Power Automate issues, coach non-technical users, and strengthen our Power Platform Center of Excellence. If you’re the kind of engineer who knows how to turn AI tooling into real organizational impact, this one’s for you.

What You’ll Own

AI Support & Troubleshooting

  • Serve as the go-to expert for Copilot Studio and Power Automate issues
  • Solve connector failures, permission problems, workflow errors, and broken automations
  • Provide fast, accurate root cause analysis

Agent Design & Optimization

  • Review and refine agents for performance, compliance, and scalability
  • Improve prompts, workflows, and architecture patterns
  • Ensure alignment with governance and platform best practices

User Enablement

  • Help employees safely build, extend, and optimize their agents
  • Explain platform capabilities and limits in accessible, non-technical language
  • Promote safe data usage and DLP-aligned behavior

Architecture & Governance

  • Apply knowledge of agent architectures, prompt lifecycles, and RAG patterns
  • Partner with security, data, and compliance teams to ensure DLP and governance alignment
  • Contribute to Power Platform Center of Excellence (COE) standards, monitoring, and lifecycle practices

Documentation & Continuous Improvement

  • Build user guides, reference patterns, troubleshooting playbooks
  • Identify recurring issues and propose scalable solutions
  • Support observability, health monitoring, and platform oversight

What You Bring

Required

  • Hands-on expertise in Microsoft Copilot Studio and Power Automate (core)
  • Strong ability to diagnose, design, and optimize agent workflows
  • Understanding of the Microsoft 365 ecosystem , DLP frameworks, and governance policies
  • Deep knowledge of agent architectures and prompt-response lifecycles
  • Excellent communication skills, especially with non-technical audiences

Preferred

  • Exposure to RAG , multi-agent orchestration, or MCP server concepts
  • Experience with observability or cost/governance monitoring
  • Familiarity with enterprise data environments (Snowflake, Dataverse, Azure Data Lake)
  • Prior involvement in a Power Platform COE

description:

  • Very strong communication, problem solving, decision making, and interpersonal skills.
  • Superior customer service, teambuilding, and conflict resolution skills.

  • Intermediate computer software skills required.

title: Shopify Developer CRO
description:
Shopify CRO Developer

Location: Remote

Compensation: USD $1,800–$2,500/month

Working Hours: 6 AM – 2 PM EST or at least 6 hours overlap within this window

Overview

We’re looking for a senior, hands-on Shopify expert to rebuild, optimize, and maintain a high-volume DTC storefront. Your work will directly impact conversion (goal: 0.85% → 1.6%+ in 90 days ) and you’ll collaborate with our CRO strategist, growth, and ops teams.

This is a technical execution role — not strategy only.

Core Responsibilities

1. Front-End Shopify Development

  • Rebuild key templates (Home, Collection, PDP, Cart, Checkout) with a mobile-first, conversion-focused approach.
  • Implement CRO/UI enhancements: trust signals, sticky ATC, bundles, urgency, reviews, upsells, cart optimization.
  • Replace heavy apps with custom code when possible to increase performance + reduce cost.

2. Speed & Performance Optimization

  • Bring load speeds under 2.5 seconds across top pages.
  • Remove theme bloat: unused scripts, oversized media, duplicate app calls.
  • Implement:
  • Code splitting
  • Minification + compression
  • Defer/async scripts
  • Lazy loading
  • Image optimization via Shopify CDN
  • Maintain a clean, version-controlled deployment workflow.

3. Conversion & Funnel Optimization

  • Diagnose and fix checkout drop-offs + friction points (Shop Pay, PayPal, Prime, etc.).
  • Improve ATC rate, product discovery, clarity, and mobile usability.
  • Implement A/B testing variants from the CRO team or propose your own.

4. Tracking, Instrumentation & Analytics

  • Configure and maintain GA4 event tracking (ATC, IC, upsells, search behavior, scroll depth, etc.).
  • Set up session recording and heatmaps (Hotjar or Clarity).
  • Interpret funnels with the team and provide actionable recommendations.

5. Reporting & Communication

  • Weekly updates on:
  • Conversion rate trends
  • AOV impacts
  • Funnel drop-off changes
  • Site issues or speed regressions
  • Maintain clear documentation and async communication with product, ops, and design.

✅ Requirements

  • 3+ years building custom Shopify themes (Liquid, JSON, JS, CSS, Shopify APIs).
  • Proven results improving mobile conversion and checkout/speed performance .
  • Hands-on experience with Dawn/OS 2.0 custom theme development .
  • Strong frontend fundamentals: modular Liquid architecture, performance-first coding, clean components.
  • Deep Shopify optimization skills: theme speed improvements, app performance audits, and custom replacements for heavy apps.
  • Experience working with high-volume DTC brands .

✨ Nice-to-Have

  • Experience with CRO tools (Rebuy, Bundler, Zipify, Okendo, Stamped).
  • GA4 modeling, attribution & Shopify Pixel system.
  • Headless / Hydrogen experience.
  • Hotjar / Clarity usage for experience analysis.
  • Familiarity with Klaviyo event triggers.
  • Experience partnering with CRO strategists, designers, or A/B testing teams.

description:

Realizar visitas e reuniões de alinhamento, apresentar o portfólio de produtos, negociar condições comerciais e desenvolver planos de negócio que impulsionem volume, rentabilidade e execução em mercado. Acompanhar indicadores de desempenho (sell-in, sell-out, cobertura, estoque e mix), assegurando o cumprimento das metas e a correta implementação das estratégias comerciais. Fortalecer o relacionamento com distribuidores e clientes estratégicos, assegurando eficiência operacional, expansão de oportunidades e aumento de participação da marca.

  • Administrar contas-chave e distribuidores da região, garantindo performance e expansão dos resultados.

  • Ensino médio concluído;
  • Experiência comprovada em Key Account, Canal Indireto ou Gestão de Distribuidores;
  • Vivência no segmento de bebidas, alimentos, bens de consumo, Farinhas (Food Service);

  • Disponibilidade para viagens e atuação em campo;
  • Domínio de Excel e ferramentas de CRM (diferencial);

  2. Etapa: Prova de Conhecimentos Gerais ou Específico
  3. Etapa: Entrevista com o RH
  4. Etapa: Entrevista com o Gestor
  5. Etapa: Contratação

Alimentar e inspirar as pessoas, transformando sonhos em realidade

Esse é o propósito que nos inspira e faz com que sejamos uma das maiores indústrias de alimentos do Brasil! Reconhecida como líder nacional nos mercados de massas e biscoitos, estamos entre as maiores companhias do mundo nesses segmentos. Com quase sete décadas de existência, marcamos presença em todo o País com marcas regionais, nacionais e, agora, no Uruguai, nossa primeira aquisição internacional! Com um amplo portfólio de produtos que são sinônimos de sabor e qualidade, temos uma relação de confiança e respeito com consumidores de vários perfis.

Atuamos nos seguintes segmentos: Biscoitos de trigo e arroz; massas de trigo e milho; farinhas e farelos de trigo; misturas para bolos; margarinas e cremes vegetais; bolos; snacks de milho e trigo; torradas; biscoitos cobertos de chocolate; pasta de amendoim; temperos e chocolates; molhos, granolas; cookies; panificação sem glúten e beneficiamento de grãos.

A partir da nossa sede, localizada na cidade de Eusébio, no Ceará, adotamos uma estratégia bem sucedida de construção e aquisição de novas indústrias. Possuímos um moderno parque industrial, com equipamentos de última geração, seguindo os mais rigorosos padrões de qualidade na produção de alimentos e operando com um modelo de integração vertical, que permite a produção de nossas mais importantes matérias-primas.

Contamos com mais de 17 mil colaboradores distribuídos em 21 unidades industriais no Brasil e 1 no Uruguai. Além disso, temos 29 centros de distribuição, estrategicamente instalados em diferentes Estados, que possibilitam a presença das nossas marcas em todo o território nacional e apoiando à exportação para mais de 40 países. Também negociamos ações no Novo Mercado da B3, bolsa de valores oficial do Brasil.

Valorizamos o respeito às pessoas e ao bem comum, considerando a diversidade como o elemento mais importante para geração de resultados e mudanças significativas. Buscamos construir um ambiente inclusivo, onde todos são respeitados, independentemente de idade, orientação sexual, gênero ou etnia. Todas as nossas oportunidades são acessíveis a pessoas com deficiência, e valorizamos a autenticidade e o potencial de cada talento.

every day. These are types of plastic with hundreds of different applications. Our customers use

these plastic pellets to create their products. Our suppliers are global producers of

petrochemicals, and we focus primarily on trading polyethylene and polypropylene.

Bridge Polymers has offices in several countries, including Spain, Poland, Romania, Brazil and

more, with our headquarters based in Eindhoven, the Netherlands. The market we operate in is

fast-paced. Thanks to our straightforward, honest, and down-to-earth company culture, we can

perform at our best even in the hectic world of fast trading. We are flexible and work with short

lines of communication, allowing us to always stay on top of the business!

Your responsibilities

Working at Bridge Polymers means working on your own future within a dynamic company. This

is especially true for the Inside Sales Specialist we are currently seeking. How your journey

unfolds and where you ultimately end up is largely in your own hands.

As an Inside Sales Specialist, you will receive a structured onboarding and development

program designed to help you quickly gain confidence in your role. From day one, you will be

actively contributing while deepening your knowledge in the following areas:

Business Development & Prospection

● Research new markets and identify potential commercial opportunities.

● Analyse import statistics and market data to uncover new prospects.

● Proactively engage with potential customers through calls, emails, and LinkedIn.

● Set up daily meetings with prospects to explore potential collaborations.

● Contact customers to understand their product requirements and gather relevant market

intelligence.

Sales Support

● Prepare, create, and send offers and proformas.

● Manage follow-ups to support the full sales cycle from lead to deal.

● Assist in applying for credit limits and monitoring customer credit status.

● Follow up on payments, required documentation, and overall deal progress.

Customer Administration

● Handle day-to-day communication with prospects and clients.

● Ensure all customer data, requests, and feedback are accurately documented and

managed.

● Support the sales team by maintaining a smooth and organized administrative workflow.

In short: an excellent career outlook - and it’s up to you to fulfil your potential.

Requirements

● You have a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Business, International trade or similar field.

● You have at least 1–2 years of experience in a sales or business development role.

● Knowledge of import/export processes and B2B sales is a strong advantage.

● You are independent, ambitious, commercially minded, proactive, and able to perform

under pressure.

● You are fluent in spoken and written English and Portuguese.

● You are currently residing in Brazil, ideally near Blumenau and willing to commute to our

office.

What we offer

● Excellent employment conditions.

● Salary progression linked to your personal growth and performance.

● Mentorship from experienced professionals to support your development.

● The opportunity to be part of a dynamic, international team.

title: Human Resources Business Partner
description:
About the Company

Our client is one of the world’s leading manufacturers of two- and three-wheelers, with a strong global presence across more than 80 countries. In Brazil, the company’s strategic expansion in Latin America and is a rapidly growing multinational motorcycle manufacturer and distributor with annual revenues exceeding BRL 300 million. With operations spanning four key locations- they serve customers across all 27 federative units. As they continue to scale our team, dealer network, and market presence, we are building a high-performance, agile, and people-first organization, and are seeking an experienced HR Business Partner to support this growth journey.

Role Overview

The HR Business Partner (HRBP) acts as a strategic advisor to business leaders across Commercial, Operations, Finance, Marketing, Sales, Dealer Development, and Support Functions in Brazil. This role is responsible for aligning HR strategy with business objectives, driving people processes, and enabling a strong performance & culture framework in a rapidly growing market.

Key Responsibilities

1. Strategic HR Partnering

  • Serve as the primary HR point-of-contact for business leaders across Brazil.
  • Understand business priorities and design HR interventions to support organizational goals.
  • Drive workforce planning, capability assessments, and talent deployment strategies.

2. Talent Acquisition & Onboarding

  • Partner with global and regional TA teams to define hiring needs and support local recruitment.
  • Oversee onboarding and cultural integration for new hires in Brazil.
  • Ensure compliance with Brazilian labour regulations during hiring and setup.

3. Performance Management

  • Drive annual and mid-year performance review processes.
  • Coach managers on goal setting, feedback, performance conversations, and development plans.
  • Support the implementation of global performance frameworks adapted to local needs.

4. Employee Relations & Compliance

  • Serve as the first point of escalation for employee issues, grievances, or policy clarification.
  • Ensure adherence to Brazil’s labour laws and internal policies.
  • Partner with legal advisors where required for sensitive ER cases.

5. Talent Development & Culture Building

  • Identify capability gaps and support local training, leadership development, and skill-building initiatives.
  • Lead cultural engagement programs in alignment with Client’s global values.
  • Support DE&I initiatives and cross-cultural employee programs.

6. HR Operations & Policy Management

  • Manage end-to-end HR lifecycle processes (payroll coordination, leaves, benefits, contract changes).
  • Collaborate with HQ in India for alignment on global HR processes.
  • Maintain HR data accuracy, dashboards, and workforce analytics for decision-making.

7. Organizational Development

  • Support org structure changes, role evaluations, job descriptions, and SOP creation for growing functions.
  • Lead change management initiatives during scale-up phases or new business launches.

Required Qualifications & Experience

  • Bachelor’s/ Masters Degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Psychology, or related field.
  • 5–10 years of HR Generalist/HRBP experience, preferably in multinational or high-growth organizations.
  • Strong understanding of Brazilian labour laws and HR compliance.
  • Experience partnering with senior stakeholders and managing end-to-end HR processes.
  • Ability to work in a multicultural environment with teams across India and LATAM.
  • Fluency in Portuguese (mandatory) and English (strong proficiency required).

Key Competencies

  • Strong stakeholder management
  • Problem-solving & decision-making
  • Cultural adaptability
  • Communication & influencing skills
  • Confidentiality and integrity
  • High ownership and agility
  • Ability to operate independently in a startup-like environment

title: Product Designer (UX/UI)

About Uitify

Uitify is a design studio specializing in delivering high-quality UI/UX and branding solutions for early-stage SaaS startups based in the United States. We are committed to transforming complex business ideas into elegant, user-centric digital experiences. With a strong emphasis on design excellence, innovation, and client collaboration, we help fast-growing companies establish strong visual identities and seamless digital products.

The Opportunity

We are looking for a highly experienced and strategic Product Designer. This role is ideal for a designer who thrives on solving complex user problems, designing for technical audiences, and delivering intuitive, scalable product experiences in fast-paced, startup environments.

The ideal candidate is a hands-on product thinker with a deep understanding of user-centered design for B2B software, a track record of shipping enterprise-grade digital products, and experience working closely with Product Managers, Engineers, and key stakeholders in the cybersecurity and SaaS sectors.

Responsibilities

  • Lead end-to-end product design processes, from discovery and research to wireframing, prototyping, and high-fidelity UI design;
  • Partner closely with Product Management and Engineering to define product requirements and translate them into user-centered design solutions;
  • Design intuitive interfaces for complex cybersecurity tools and SaaS products, focusing on usability, scalability, and performance;
  • Conduct user research, usability testing, and heuristic evaluations to validate design decisions and optimize user experience;
  • Collaborate with stakeholders to align design goals with business objectives, technical constraints, and customer needs;
  • Create and maintain design systems and UI libraries to ensure consistency and efficiency across the product suite;
  • Stay updated on cybersecurity trends, user behavior patterns in B2B software, and industry best practices in product design;
  • Mentor junior designers and provide design critique and feedback within the team.

Requirements

  • Full professional proficiency in English (verbal and written), with the ability to clearly articulate design rationale and collaborate with international teams;
  • Strong portfolio showcasing complex product design work for enterprise software, especially in security, data visualization, or technical tools;
  • Deep expertise with design tools like Figma, FigJam, and prototyping tools such as Framer or Principle;
  • Solid understanding of user flows, interaction design, information architecture, and visual hierarchy for B2B software;
  • Experience working in agile development environments, with strong collaboration skills alongside Product Managers and Engineers;
  • Familiarity with design systems, accessibility standards (WCAG), and responsive design principles.

Preferred Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience as a Product Designer
  • Direct experience designing for cybersecurity platforms (e.g., threat detection tools, security dashboards, monitoring platforms, etc.);
  • Background in designing data-heavy interfaces, with complex user journeys and role-based user permissions;
  • Knowledge of frontend development principles (HTML, CSS) to effectively communicate with developers;
  • Prior experience working with US-based startups or product teams;
  • Experience facilitating design workshops, user interviews, or stakeholder alignment sessions.

Why Join Us?

At Uitify, you will work on high-impact projects for fast-growing SaaS and cybersecurity companies, helping shape the digital tools that protect and empower businesses worldwide. You’ll collaborate with talented designers and technologists, contribute to cutting-edge design solutions, and grow your career in a studio that values innovation, ownership, and excellence.

Adapt global brand assets for the Brazilian market, infusing them with local aesthetic sensibilities.

Stay ahead of Brazilian design trends (e.g., street art influences, vibrant color palettes) and integrate them into illustrations. Use design software (Adobe Suite, Procreate) and explore AI-assisted illustration tools (e.g., for rapid prototyping).

  • Portfolio showcasing: Illustration as a strategic tool (e.g., illustrated campaign assets, character design, data visualization). Proven ability to localize foreign brands for Brazilian audiences. Strong typography, layout, and color theory skills.
  • In-depth knowledge of Brazilian culture, aesthetics, and market trends.
  • Proficiency in design tools (Photoshop, Illustrator, After Effects) and project management.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in animation or motion graphics (e.g., illustrated explainer videos).
  • Familiarity with interactive design (e.g., micro-interactions for social media).

title: Regional Systems Manager
description:
Responsible for leading our technology implementation and operational efforts. This role is responsible for the strategic planning, coordination, and execution of systems integration projects, while also overseeing the company's broader IT infrastructure, security, and support functions. He/she will ensure that all technology initiatives are delivered on time, within budget, and aligned with business objectives, while maintaining the day-to-day health and efficiency of our IT environment.

  • Develop and implement IT policies, procedures, and best practices for security, data integrity, and system reliability.
  • Manage IT service desk and support functions to resolve issues efficiently and maintain high user satisfaction.
  • Establish and manage the PMO framework, ensuring adherence to project management methodologies.

Team & Leadership:

  • Lead, mentor, and motivate cross-functional teams, including internal staff, external contractors, and vendors.
  • Manage resource allocation across both project and operational workstreams.

Risk & Security Management:

  • Identify, evaluate, and mitigate risks that may affect project implementation or IT operations.
  • Develop and maintain IT disaster recovery and business continuity plans, aligned with Group policy and procedures.

Project & Systems Integration Management:

  • Lead the end-to-end implementation of technology projects, including scope definition, milestone planning, timeline development, budget management, and vendor negotiations.
  • Coordinate all project activities across different business areas, vendors, developers, systems analysts, and consultants.

Stakeholder Communication & Reporting:

  • Facilitate regular meetings and prepare detailed reports to ensure transparency and accuracy of information.
  • Act as a key liaison between the IT department and other business units.

  • Communication: Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to convey complex technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders clearly and concisely.
  • Technical Proficiency: Solid understanding of IT infrastructure, cybersecurity principles, software development lifecycles, and cloud services.
  • Project Management: Proven knowledge of project management methodologies.

title: Venture Capital Analyst
description:
About Evvolve & Partners

Evvolve & Partners is a global financial and strategic advisory firm that connects visionary entrepreneurs with strategic capital. We support innovative companies in scaling through high-impact capital partnerships, leveraging our international investor network, deep market intelligence, and long-term value–driven approach. Our work goes beyond traditional capital matchmaking—combining proprietary sourcing, strategic insight, and a commitment to supporting founders throughout their growth journey.

Role Overview

We are seeking a highly organized and analytically minded Venture Capital Analyst with a strong focus on developing investor-facing materials. In this role, you will craft, refine, and manage core content that supports our portfolio companies throughout their fundraising journeys—including pitch decks, one-pagers, and strategic narratives.

This position is ideal for someone who understands the venture landscape and excels at translating complex business models into compelling investment materials. You will collaborate with internal teams, portfolio founders, and design partners to ensure each presentation is both insightful and visually aligned with Evvolve’s high standards.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead the creation, iteration, and finalization of investment materials (e.g., pitch decks, one-pagers, fundraising briefs).
  • Synthesize business models, market analyses, and competitive landscapes into concise and impactful presentations.
  • Collaborate closely with founders, internal deal teams, and design resources to ensure alignment in messaging, structure, and visuals.
  • Apply insights from investor conversations and market trends to tailor narratives for specific capital partners.
  • Ensure materials meet the strategic objectives of each raise while adhering to Evvolve’s brand and communication standards.
  • Maintain strong quality control and consistency across deliverables, often managing several projects simultaneously.

What We’re Looking For

  • 1–3 years of experience in venture capital, private equity, investment banking, consulting, or a comparable analyst-level role.
  • Strong proficiency in presentation tools (PowerPoint required; Figma a strong plus).
  • Clear understanding of early-stage fundraising processes and startup growth dynamics.
  • Exceptional written communication skills with the ability to synthesize complex ideas into compelling content.
  • Detail-oriented, proactive, and capable of managing multiple workflows in a fast-paced environment.
  • Collaborative mindset and strong sense of ownership over deliverables.

Why Join Us

  • Join a mission-driven team shaping the future of venture capital and innovation.
  • Work with a global network of top-tier investors and high-impact founders.
  • Gain exposure to diverse sectors—from AI to sustainability to frontier technologies.
  • Play a critical role in the capital-raising process for fast-growing ventures.
  • Enjoy a flexible work environment with opportunities for global travel and cross-office collaboration.

title: Price and Promotion Consulting and Implementation Manager
description:
dunnhumby is the global leader in Customer Data Science, partnering with the world’s most ambitious retailers and brands to put the customer at the heart of every decision. We combine deep insight, advanced technology, and close collaboration to help our clients grow, innovate, and deliver measurable value for their customers.

dunnhumby employs nearly 2,500 experts in offices throughout Europe, Asia, Africa, and the Americas working for transformative, iconic brands such as Tesco, Coca-Cola, Nestlé, Unilever and Metro.

We are looking for Price and Promotion Consulting and Implementation Manager who can apply technology to promote the success of our retail clients while addressing business requirements through workflow design, configuring software for optimal client results, and conducting training in accordance with best practices. The Price and Promotion consulting and implementation manager will lead the deployment of dunnhumby’s P&P solutions to new and existing clients. They will work closely with the client’s teams to understand their requirements and ensure that our tools are fit for purpose.

Responsibilities

  • Lead the delivery of P&P Products: Ensure the timely and successful delivery of price and promotion software solutions that meet client’s needs and objectives, in line with the project plan. Analyse large and complex datasets to identify potential gaps and inconsistencies during the deployment process.
  • Drive Change: Develop and maintain trusted advisor relationships with client teams, guiding them through change by implementing new price and promotional processes. Work closely with the product teams to influence the roadmap based on clients’ feedback and develop new features collaboratively.
  • Process & Requirements Documentation: Understand and document the client’s current processes, identify and organize their business and process requirements, and work with the Price & Promotion Consulting Director and the wider team to recommend best-in-class solutions.
  • Software Configuration & Testing: Configure enterprise price and promotions software to align with specific client processes and needs. Develop and implement internal and external testing processes. Perform testing and analysis of data to ensure accuracy and effectiveness of software solutions.
  • GO Live support: Contribute to the successful execution of the GO Live phase by demonstrating the tool’s added value to the client. This involves organizing and participating in client sessions, conducting category analysis, proposing optimal solutions, and monitoring progress through measurement, reporting, and activity tracking.

Required Experience

  • Extensive experience working at a retailer/ FMCG within the Merchandising space and in enterprise software implementations. Specific expertise in Price and Promotions solutions desirable
  • A college degree or equivalent professional experience required
  • Strong business analysis and data analytics skills. Data visualization, advanced Microsoft Excel, programming language a plus
  • Support pre-sales activities and lead generation in coordination with Sales and Client teams to ensure the proper positioning of our P&P solutions to meet clients’ needs.
  • Experience in project management and workflow optimization

What you can expect from us

We won’t just meet your expectations. We’ll defy them. So you’ll enjoy the comprehensive rewards package you’d expect from a leading technology company. But also, a degree of personal flexibility you might not expect. Plus, thoughtful perks, like flexible working hours and your birthday off.

You’ll also benefit from an investment in cutting-edge technology that reflects our global ambition. But with a nimble, small-business feel that gives you the freedom to play, experiment and learn.

And we don’t just talk about diversity and inclusion. We live it every day – with thriving networks including dh Gender Equality Network, dh Proud, dh Family, dh One, dh Enabled and dh Thrive as the living proof. We want everyone to have the opportunity to shine and perform at your best throughout our recruitment process. Please let us know how we can make this process work best for you.

Our approach to Flexible Working

At dunnhumby, we value and respect difference and are committed to building an inclusive culture by creating an environment where you can balance a successful career with your commitments and interests outside of work.

We believe that you will do your best at work if you have a work / life balance. Some roles lend themselves to flexible options more than others, so if this is important to you please raise this with your recruiter, as we are open to discussing agile working opportunities during the hiring process.

title: Facilities Manager
description:
MISSION

Lead and oversee all Facilities operations across Corporate Offices, R&D Labs, Manufacturing Plant, and Distribution Center, ensuring safe, efficient, compliant, and cost-effective infrastructure. Act as the key connection between local operations and global standards for EHS, Engineering, and Sustainability.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Ensure a safe work environment by promoting a strong safety culture and full compliance with legal requirements, NRs, company HSE policies, and global corporate standards.
  • Guarantee the integrity, reliability, and availability of all facilities infrastructure, including utilities, HVAC, electrical systems, water treatment, fire protection, building automation, and critical assets.
  • Lead, develop, and oversee internal and outsourced teams (maintenance, cleaning, security, reception, gardening, cafeteria, and services).
  • Manage preventive, corrective, and predictive maintenance programs, ensuring uptime and operational continuity for Office, R&D Labs, Manufacturing, and Distribution Center.
  • Oversee facilities services to ensure high service levels, cost efficiency, and adherence to SLAs.
  • Lead improvement initiatives to enhance energy efficiency, sustainability, waste reduction, and operational performance.
  • Ensure compliance with certifications, internal audits, external audits, and global standards (ISO, GMP where applicable).
  • Oversee space planning, workplace strategy, building layout updates, and occupancy optimization.
  • Manage construction projects, renovations, expansions, and infrastructure modifications from planning to delivery, ensuring alignment with Capex governance.
  • Coordinate incident management, emergency response plans, fire brigade activities, and building security protocols.
  • Monitor and manage facilities KPIs, identifying root causes and implementing corrective and preventive actions.
  • Manage Opex and Capex budgets, ensuring cost optimization and adherence to financial targets.
  • Collaborate with key internal stakeholders (Manufacturing, R&D, Supply Chain, HR, IT, Security, Finance) to ensure seamless and compliant operations.
  • Ensure vendor management excellence, including contract negotiation, performance monitoring, compliance, and continuous improvement.
  • Serve as the main point of contact for facilities matters with local leadership and global functional teams.

REQUIREMENTS

  • Bachelor’s degree in Engineering (Civil, Electrical, Mechanical), Architecture, Business Administration, or related fields.
  • Experience managing Facilities operations across multi-site or complex environments (Office, Industrial, Logistics, or R&D).
  • Minimum of 5 years of proven leadership experience in maintenance, utilities, infrastructure, or facilities services.
  • Strong technical background in building systems (HVAC, electrical, utilities, fire systems).
  • Demonstrated experience in maintenance management, vendor management, and project leadership.
  • Solid understanding of Brazilian regulatory requirements (NRs), engineering standards, and EHS.
  • Proven experience in managing Capex and Opex budgets.
  • Experience in multinational environments is strongly preferred.
  • Proficiency in SAP and Microsoft Office (Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook).
  • Strong analytical, organizational, and problem-solving skills.
  • Advanced English is mandatory.

SOFT SKILLS

  • Ownership mindset, with strong presence in operations and a hands-on approach.
  • High level of discipline, organization, and operational rigor.
  • Intellectual curiosity and continuous learning mindset.
  • Agile, creative, and solution-oriented profile.
  • Strong critical thinking and ability to anticipate risks.
  • Ability to lead multidisciplinary teams with engagement and accountability.
  • Strong communication, collaboration, and stakeholder management skills.

Resilience and ability to deliver impactful results under pressure.

title: Resource Manager, Professional Services
description:
Title: Resource Manager, Professional Services

Business Unit: Graphic Communications

Department: Customer & Professional Services

Location: Brazil, Remote

About us

Graphic Communications, a CAI Division, is a leading global provider of industry-specific business and production software technology for the print industy. Graphic Communications’ integrated and automated offerings and point solutions are designed to enable revenue growth and drive operating and production efficiencies. With over thirty years dedicated to delivering best-in-class technology to the packaging and printing industries, it is the company's deeply held philosophy that they succeed when its customers thrive.

Position Overview

The Resource Manager plays a critical role in ensuring Professional Services teams are properly staffed, aligned, and equipped to meet project timelines and business objectives. This role involves close collaboration with Project Managers, Project Coordinators, Regional Managers, the Sr. Director of Professional Services, Customer Success, and Sales to efficiently manage resources, balance workloads, and ensure smooth project delivery.

Core Responsibilities

Resource Planning and Allocation

  • Identify, assign, and allocate resources to ongoing and upcoming projects based on skills, availability, and priorities.
  • Maintain a real-time view of resource capacity and project needs across the organization.
  • Serve as the primary point of contact for project staffing and collaborate with Sales and Regional Managers to ensure proper coverage for upcoming engagements.
  • Own all new engagements at intake and assign resources based on availability and skillset.
  • Check in regularly with Project Managers to confirm they have the resources required for project success.
  • Maintain up-to-date skills and certifications records for all consultants. Forecasting and Talent Management
  • Collaborate with Sales, Project Managers, Regional Managers, and leadership to forecast future resource requirements.
  • Identify resource gaps and recommend cross-training, recruitment, or subcontracting needs based on upcoming opportunities.
  • Support long-term workforce planning and professional development of consultants.

Process Optimization and Tool Management

  • Develop and maintain tools, dashboards, and reports to monitor utilization, productivity, and performance.
  • Establish and enforce consistent processes for resource requests and assignments to maximize efficiency.
  • Ensure data and processes remain aligned across systems.

Daily Operational Responsibilities

New Engagement Intake

  • Review new projects pushed from Salesforce into Wrike.
  • Confirm all project metadata: customer, region, product, estimated hours, and key contacts.
  • Confirm the correct Wrike template and folder structure were created.
  • If automation fails, manually create projects using Salesforce data.

Assignment & Scheduling

  • Review unassigned Wrike projects daily.
  • Match consultants to projects based on skill set, availability, and regional needs.
  • Assign both primary and secondary consultants and confirm schedules with stakeholders.
  • Flag any assignment conflicts or delays to Regional Managers or Services Leads.

System Sync and Integration Oversight

  • Cross-reference Salesforce → Wrike and Wrike → NetSuite mappings to ensure accuracy.
  • Validate billing fields (sold-to ID, billing trigger, engagement type) and confirm correct syncing.
  • Ensure Concur sync processes are updating users, vendors, and expenses accurately.
  • Monitor Wrike integration logs and escalate issues as needed.
  • Maintain field mapping and oversee sync processes across Salesforce, NetSuite, and Concur.
  • Track and resolve open integration issues in collaboration with Operations.

Time Tracking Oversight

  • Validate daily timesheet entries for all consultants.
  • Identify missing, misallocated, or excessive time entries and follow up as needed.
  • Escalate persistent noncompliance to Regional Managers.
  • Ensure adherence to time entry policies for accurate utilization and billing reporting.

Project Health & Status Monitoring

  • Monitor project dashboards in Wrike for task completion, budget consumption, and forecasted effort.

Reporting & Communication

  • Participate in regular syncs with Regional Managers.
  • Track upcoming projects, resourcing constraints, and urgent escalations.
  • Respond to inquiries regarding capacity, project swaps, or timeline adjustments.
  • Provide data for utilization, staffing, revenue forecasting, and any other Professional Services metrics.

Performance and Collaboration

  • Monitor workload balance across consultants.
  • Participate in resource reviews with Regional Managers to support continuous development based on Sales forecast.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with Sales, Customer Success, and Professional Services teams to align timelines, priorities, and dependencies.

Qualifications

Experience:

  • 4+ years of experience in resource planning or operations within a software or technology organization.
  • Proven ability to manage multiple concurrent projects and balance resources effectively in a fast-paced environment.

Skills:

  • Strong proficiency with resource planning tools (e.g., Wrike)
  • Working knowledge of JIRA, Salesforce, required, and NetSuite preferred.
  • Excellent organizational, communication, and negotiation skills.

title: Pessoa Supervisora de Auditoria e Performance
description:
ALLOS é uma marca com uma forte herança. São cerca de 50 anos de experiência, transformando o mercado no Brasil. Somos referência em excelência e inovação, com a qualidade e confiança que faz parte da nossa história.

A nova marca surgiu pronta para o futuro, a partir da fusão entre a Aliansce Sonae e a brMalls, em 2023. Mas, essa trajetória começou bem antes.

Tudo começou com a Aliansce, que inaugurou o primeiro shopping da região Nordeste e o segundo do Brasil em 1975. Em 2019, a fusão entre a Aliansce e a Sonae Sierra deu origem à Aliansce Sonae, tornando-se líder na administração de shoppings no Brasil, com 32 empreendimentos. Em 2006, surge a brMalls resultando em um portfólio de 30 ativos presentes nas cinco regiões do país.

E assim, em 2023, a ALLOS surge com o encontro de duas potências nacionais do segmento, unindo forças para se tornar a mais inovadora plataforma de entretenimento, lifestyle, serviços e compras.

Nossa história continua e estamos prontos para criar momentos que transformam e impactam a vida das pessoas, gerando conexões e oportunidades.

title: Lead WordPress Developer
description:
Given that this position requires English proficiency, we are only considering CV's provided in English. Thank you, and we look forward to your submission!

About Olly Olly

Olly Olly is a $25M ARR digital marketing company serving small businesses across the United States. We've built our reputation on transparency, results, and making sophisticated marketing accessible to business owners who need to focus on running their companies, not learning marketing complexities. As we scale our platform and demand generation efforts, we're looking for an exceptional WordPress developer who can lead our landing page creation and optimization function.

The Role

We're seeking a battle-tested WordPress Developer & Landing Page Team Lead who has personally managed the technical execution of high-stakes marketing campaigns with millions of dollars in ad spend. This isn't a role for someone who's built a few landing pages—we need someone who has been THE person responsible for ensuring every pixel fires correctly, every form submits properly, and every dollar of ad spend has a clear path to conversion tracking.

You'll lead a team of two WordPress developers, managing multiple concurrent projects while maintaining the exacting standards required when significant marketing budgets are on the line. You'll be the technical bridge between our marketing campaigns (primarily Meta, but across various channels) and our HubSpot CRM, ensuring flawless data flow and attribution tracking.

Core Responsibilities

Landing Page Development & Campaign Execution

  • Design, build, and deploy high-converting landing pages optimized for paid traffic from Meta, Google, and other advertising platforms
  • Own the complete technical implementation of marketing campaigns from concept through launch
  • Ensure pixel-perfect tracking setup across all campaigns, including Meta Pixel, Google Analytics, conversion tracking, and retargeting audiences
  • Implement and troubleshoot complex tracking scenarios including server-side tracking, UTM parameters, and multi-touch attribution
  • Optimize landing page performance for speed, mobile responsiveness, and conversion rates
  • Conduct A/B testing and implement rapid iterations based on campaign performance data

HubSpot Integration & Data Management

  • Build and maintain seamless integrations between landing pages and HubSpot CRM
  • Ensure accurate lead capture, form submissions, and data synchronization
  • Implement and validate proper lead source attribution and campaign tracking in HubSpot
  • Create custom workflows and automations to support campaign objectives
  • Troubleshoot data discrepancies and ensure marketing attribution accuracy

Technical Leadership & Team Management

  • Lead and mentor a team of two WordPress developers
  • Manage workload distribution across multiple concurrent projects and campaigns
  • Establish and enforce development standards, quality assurance protocols, and best practices
  • Conduct code reviews and provide constructive technical feedback
  • Create project timelines and ensure on-time delivery of campaign assets
  • Serve as the escalation point for complex technical challenges

Quality Assurance & Risk Management

  • Implement rigorous QA processes, before any campaign launch.
  • Verify all tracking mechanisms are functioning correctly across devices and browsers
  • Maintain detailed documentation of tracking implementations and technical specifications
  • Proactively identify and resolve potential issues before they impact campaign performance
  • Ensure compliance with privacy regulations (GDPR, CCPA) in all tracking implementations

Required Qualifications

  • 5+ years of professional WordPress development experience
  • Direct experience managing technical execution of marketing campaigns with $1M+ in total ad spend
  • Must have been the PRIMARY person responsible for landing page build and campaign launch (not just a contributor on a larger team)
  • Portfolio demonstrating high-converting landing pages you've personally built and deployed

Technical Expertise

  • Proven experience implementing Git-based version control (GitLab, GitHub, or Bitbucket) and configuring Continuous Integration/Continuous Delivery (CI/CD) pipelines for WordPress. Must be proficient in automating deployment across environments (Dev, Staging, Prod) and integrating unit and end-to-end tests into the workflow.
  • Expert-level WordPress development skills including ACF. Gutenberg, custom theme development, plugin customization, and advanced page builders (Elementor, Divi, or similar)
  • Deep understanding of Meta Business Suite, Meta Pixel implementation, and Conversions API
  • Proven experience with HubSpot CRM integration, forms, and tracking implementation
  • Strong command of HTML, CSS, JavaScript/jQuery, and PHP
  • Experience with VueJS is a plus
  • Experience with conversion tracking pixels across multiple platforms (Meta, Google, LinkedIn, etc.)
  • Knowledge of Google Tag Manager and server-side tracking implementations
  • Understanding of marketing analytics, attribution models, and conversion optimization principles

Management & Communication

  • Demonstrated experience leading and mentoring developers
  • Exceptional project management skills with the ability to juggle multiple high-priority projects
  • Clear communication style with both technical and non-technical stakeholders
  • Comfortable with accountability when significant marketing budgets are at stake
  • Ability to explain complex technical concepts to marketing team members

Performance Standards

  • Meticulous attention to detail—one misconfigured pixel can cost thousands in wasted ad spend
  • Ability to work under pressure and meet tight campaign launch deadlines
  • Proactive problem-solver who anticipates issues before they become problems
  • Commitment to continuous learning as platforms and tracking methods evolve

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with marketing automation platforms beyond HubSpot (Marketo, Pardot, ActiveCampaign)
  • Familiarity with conversion rate optimization (CRO) methodologies and tools
  • Knowledge of SQL for custom reporting and data analysis
  • Experience with A/B testing platforms (VWO, Optimizely, Google Optimize)
  • Understanding of SEO best practices for landing pages
  • Certifications in Meta Blueprint, Google Analytics, or HubSpot
  • Experience in agency or fast-paced startup environments

What Success Looks Like

First 30 Days

  • Audit current landing page infrastructure and tracking implementations
  • Meet with marketing team to understand campaign objectives and conversion goals
  • Review existing team workflows and identify optimization opportunities
  • Successfully launch first campaign under your management with zero tracking issues

First 90 Days

  • Establish standardized QA protocols and documentation for all campaign launches
  • Implement improvements to team efficiency and project management processes
  • Build trust with marketing team through flawless technical execution
  • Identify and resolve any lingering tracking or integration issues

First Year

  • Lead team through successful execution of major product launch campaigns
  • Demonstrably improve landing page conversion rates through testing and optimization
  • Establish Olly Olly's landing page function as a competitive advantage
  • Develop your team members' skills and create succession planning

Why This Role Matters

When we invest in marketing campaigns, every dollar needs to count. You'll be the person ensuring that our tracking is accurate, our data is clean, and our ability to optimize is never compromised by technical issues. Your work directly impacts our ability to scale profitably and serve more small business owners.

Compensation & Benefits

Competitive salary commensurate with experience, plus comprehensive benefits package. This is a full-time remote position, though you'll be working closely with team members across time zones.

Our Culture

We value directness, authenticity, and results over politics or polish. We're building something meaningful for small business owners who are often underserved by the marketing industry. We expect excellence but also recognize that real growth happens when people are supported, challenged, and given autonomy to do their best work.

title: Conversational AI Designer (Voice & Chat)
description:
Company Description

A Coru é líder em soluções de experiência de usuário para empresas, focada em desafiar o convencional por meio de sua plataforma inteligente e assistente digital ADI. Job Description

O Conversational AI Designer será responsável por desenhar, construir e otimizar agentes de IA (voz e chat) que interagem com usuários finais em casos de uso financeiros, operacionais e comerciais. É um cargo híbrido entre levantamento de requisitos, design conversacional e construção técnica do agente utilizando ferramentas no-code/low-code como ElevenLabs, ADI e plataformas de voicebots. Sua missão é garantir experiências conversacionais naturais, eficientes e alinhadas ao negócio, trabalhando em conjunto com POs, clientes e equipes técnicas.

Responsabilidades:

1. Discovery e levantamento de requisitos

  • Entrevistar stakeholders e mapear os journeys atuais (AS IS);
  • Analisar casos de uso, riscos, cenários críticos e métricas desejadas.

  • Criar fluxos, árvores conversacionais e intents;
  • Definir tom, personalidade e estilo do agente de IA;
  • Redigir diálogos naturais e eficientes (português/espanhol);
  • Estabelecer estratégias de manejo de objeções, quedas e redirecionamentos;
  • Validar a experiência conversacional em diferentes canais (voz, WhatsApp, web);
  • Apoiar equipes internas com ajustes avançados de lógica e estruturação de instruções do agente, garantindo clareza, consistência e eficácia nos comportamentos esperados.

3. Construção do agente

  • Implementar o voicebot/chatbot em ferramentas internas (ADI) ou plataformas equivalentes;
  • Configurar parâmetros, memória, contexto e comportamento do agente;
  • Integrar ElevenLabs para a voz do agente (TTS, sotaques, SSML opcional);
  • Realizar testes end-to-end e ajustar o comportamento com base em métricas reais.

4. Otimização e melhoria contínua

  • Analisar gravações, transcrições e dados de performance;
  • Ajustar instruções, lógica e fluxos para melhorar conversão e CSAT;
  • Garantir qualidade, consistência e cumprimento regulatório (quando aplicável).

Requisitos Obrigatórios

  • Experiência prévia no desenho de chatbots ou voicebots (mínimo 1 ano).
  • Conhecimento em design de diálogos, UX conversacional e fluxos de decisão.
  • Capacidade de levantar requisitos diretamente com clientes.
  • Excelentes habilidades de redação e comunicação.
  • Espanhol nativo ou avançado + português intermediário (desejável).
  • Familiaridade com ferramentas de IA generativa (ChatGPT, LLMs etc.).
  • Capacidade de trabalhar com equipes de produto e desenvolvimento.
  • Conhecimento de ElevenLabs, Twilio, Dialogflow, Rasa ou similares.
  • Experiência básica com JSON, chamadas de API ou integrações simples.

Você tem o perfil para ser um Coru?

Temos a convicção de que o mais importante de Coru são as pessoas, por isso é fundamental que você faça um “Fit” cultural com toda a equipe. Estes são os pilares da nossa cultura:

title: Senior Growth Manager
description:
About us

We are a leading global player in the digital assets industry, operating one of the most advanced and trusted ecosystems in the blockchain space. With a user base exceeding 120 million worldwide, our platform offers a comprehensive suite of digital asset products and services designed to meet the needs of both retail and institutional clients.

Our mission is to accelerate the evolution of the digital economy by enabling secure, intelligent, and efficient transactions. We believe digital assets are redefining the foundations of global finance — and we are committed to empowering that transformation responsibly.

As one of the fastest-growing organizations in the sector, we foster a culture of innovation, integrity, and excellence. For professionals seeking meaningful challenges, cutting-edge projects, and the opportunity to shape the future of finance, we provide an environment that values both expertise and vision.

What you'll do

  • Drive overall business expansion across the Brazil region, setting strategies and delivering measurable growth.
  • Oversee business development, marketing, and operations with a deep understanding of growth levers to boost user acquisition and trading activity.
  • Operate as a true business owner—design new initiatives to elevate operational excellence, refine the local business model, and execute plans end-to-end.
  • Build, mentor, and lead a high-performing local team, determining hiring needs and shaping the long-term market strategy.
  • Manage budgeting, P&L performance, and financial goals to meet user and trading volume targets.
  • Lead major local marketing efforts, including partnership development and the execution of key events.
  • Serve as the company’s representative at local events, in media engagements, and in communications with external stakeholders.

What You’ll Need

  • A minimum of 5 years of experience with demonstrated success in a comparable leadership role.
  • Exceptional interpersonal abilities and proven leadership skills with an entrepreneurial mindset.
  • A strong passion for the cryptocurrency space.
  • Native-level proficiency in Spanish and English.

title: Front End AI Engineer
description:
Position Overview:

We are seeking a Front End AI Engineer with deep expertise in building high-quality, production-ready interfaces for AI-powered applications. This role focuses on leading the front-end architecture for advanced AI systems, including conversational interfaces, agent control panels, automation dashboards, and embedded AI workflows for client deployments. The ideal candidate is fluent in modern React, highly skilled in TypeScript, comfortable working across design systems, and efficient with AI-assisted development tools such as Cursor and Claude Code.

This is a senior-level role where you will serve as the point person for all front-end initiatives across multiple client projects. You will collaborate closely with our AI, automation, and product teams to translate complex agentic and generative AI capabilities into intuitive, reliable, and high-performance user experiences.

Key Responsibilities:

Front End Architecture and Development

  • Own the front-end strategy and implementation for AI-powered products and interfaces.
  • Build high-quality React applications using TypeScript, modular component architectures, and modern state management patterns.
  • Experience with design and Figma.
  • Use AI-enhanced development tools such as Cursor and Claude Code to accelerate development, improve quality, and maintain consistency across projects.
  • Design reusable component libraries tailored for AI interfaces, including chat interfaces, agent dashboards, workflow builders, analytics panels, and data visualization.
  • Ensure UX clarity when surfacing complex AI behavior, including agent states, reasoning paths, confidence indicators, and human-in-the-loop controls.
  • Coordinate with the backend and AI engineering teams to integrate REST APIs, WebSockets, vector search endpoints, automation pipelines, and generative model outputs.
  • Lead code reviews, establish front-end standards, and mentor engineers on best practices in AI-driven front-end development.

AI Interface Development

  • Build highly responsive conversational UI components for voice and text-based agents.
  • Develop systems to visualize agentic operations, multi-step workflows, and tool usage.
  • Implement secure user authentication and permissions for client-facing AI dashboards.
  • Work with designers to translate conceptual AI workflows into intuitive user flows and polished UI.
  • Collaborate with the AI engineering team to improve prompt workflows, data capture, and human override safety controls from the front-end layer.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Serve as the primary owner and technical authority for front-end delivery across all AI engagements.
  • Work closely with product managers, designers, AI engineers, and automation specialists to define scope and translate requirements into clear front-end plans.
  • Help clients understand interface possibilities and guide them toward the most effective implementation strategies.
  • Ensure that front-end systems meet client needs around reliability, accessibility, and performance.

Qualifications:

Required

  • 5+ years of professional experience as a front-end engineer.
  • Expert-level proficiency in React and TypeScript.
  • Design experience and using tools like Figma.
  • Demonstrated experience owning complex front-end applications from architecture through deployment.
  • Comfortable with AI-enhanced coding tools such as Cursor, Claude Code, and related platforms.
  • Familiarity with building AI-enabled interfaces, including chat UIs, real-time dashboards, visual workflows, or similar components.
  • Strong experience with API integration, authentication, and state management patterns.
  • Ability to work independently, set technical direction, and mentor less experienced developers.
  • Strong UX instincts and the ability to translate technical AI functionality into clear and usable interfaces.

Preferred

  • Experience building interfaces for LLM-powered systems, automation workflows, or agent-based applications.
  • Familiarity with vector databases, embeddings, or retrieval augmented UIs.
  • Experience with streaming updates, event-driven front-end patterns, or real-time systems.
  • Background in building interfaces for enterprise clients or complex operational environments.
  • Experience collaborating with AI engineers on prompt workflows and agent control features.

Work Environment and Benefits

  • Competitive compensation structure with performance incentives.
  • Flexible remote or hybrid work environment.
  • Opportunity to shape the front-end architecture for cutting-edge AI systems across multiple industries.
  • High-impact work with clients committed to modernization and operational transformation.

description:

Atuar como parceiro estratégico das áreas de negócio, liderando auditorias internas e garantindo conformidade com normas regulatórias, políticas corporativas e melhores práticas de governança. O profissional será responsável por avaliar riscos, propor melhorias e assegurar a integridade dos processos em áreas como Jurídico, Financeiro, Compras (Procurement), Compliance e Tecnologia.

  • Graduação em Administração, Ciências Contábeis, Direito, Economia ou áreas correlatas.
